messages:
Olivia: Quick pulse — final copy for the Pricing Quick Estimator + new tier names before we push the launch post today? Planning to post at 11:30 PT. Draft here: https://docs.redwood/pricing/quick-estimator-draft
Ben: On it. Is the FAQ update included? Last PR had two unresolved lines re: committed discounts and freemium limits.
Sanjay: I tested the calculator with EU VAT on staging — numbers look right, but the CTA 'Estimate monthly' reads weird for annual/committed customers.
Marta: CS check — for inbound routing can we tag leads who run >1M tokens/mo? Route those to AE queue for Dedicated upsell. Suggest hidden form param: lead_tier=estimator_high_usage.
Kevin: Product callout — prefer tier names 'Starter / Scale / Enterprise' over 'Core / Growth / Premium' for clarity in sales ops. Also add a 1-line descriptor under each tier.
Olivia: Good call on names. Ben — can you paste the final FAQ blurb? I need it for the post copy.
Ben: Draft FAQ blurb:
```
Q: How do committed discounts work?
A: Commitments are monthly or annual, applied as credits on invoice. Discounts scale with commit size; see commit tiers in the estimator.
```
Updated CTA to 'Estimate my price' in the draft.
Marta: CS: please be careful with the 'data never leaves your VPC' line — legal asked we use 'customer-managed network controls' in Dedicated copy. I'll push exact phrasing.
Kevin: Tiny tweak request: change CTA variation 'Estimate my price' -> 'Estimate price for my org' to signal account-level intent. Recommend A/B test.
Olivia: Love the A/B idea. Sanjay, can you wire the variant flag and analytics? Deploy-bot, can you schedule the experiment start?
deploy-bot: Experiment flag 'pricing_estimator_cta_v2' created; rollout scheduled at 11:35 PT to prod/us-west-2. Details: https://deploys.redwood/flags/pricing_estimator_cta_v2 :white_check_mark:
Ben: Final checklist before post: copy -> done, screenshot -> update needed (staging screenshot attached), inbound routing -> Marta to confirm, analytics event -> Sanjay to add, legal microcopy -> Kevin to sign off.
Marta: Confirmed inbound routing param + AE queue mapping. I'll paste the runbook in #support after publish.
Olivia: Great — I'll post at 11:30 PT and ping #general. Thanks team :rocket:
